items.exampleEn: Whom did you meet at the party?
Go straight ahead, and you will see the station.
items.exampleZh: 直直往前走，你就會看到車站。

items.exampleEn: Nobody was at home when I called.
items.exampleZh: 我打電話過去的時候，家裡沒有人。

items.exampleEn: It was raining. Therefore, we stayed inside.
items.exampleZh: 當時在下雨，因此我們待在室內。

items.exampleEn: The people at the party were mostly students.
items.exampleZh: 派對上的人大多是學生。

items.exampleEn: It was expensive, but I bought it anyway.
items.exampleZh: 那個很貴，但我還是買了。

items.exampleEn: Apparently, the shop is closed today.

items.sentenceEn: Nobody knows the answer to this question.
items.sentenceZh: 沒有人知道這個問題的答案。

items.audioEn: We are mostly busy in the morning, so please come in the afternoon.
items.audioZh: 我們大多在早上比較忙，所以請下午再來。
items.questionZh: 說話的人希望對方什麼時候來？

items.sentenceEn: Hey, are you free this evening?
I was tired, but I went to work anyway.
items.sentenceZh: 我很累，但我還是去上班了。

items.stemEn: ____ came to the meeting, so we went home.
items.stemZh: 沒有人來開會，所以我們就回家了。

items.stemEn: The bus was late. ____, I missed my train.
items.stemZh: 公車誤點了，因此我沒趕上火車。

items.passageEn: Last Saturday, Kevin had a party at his home, but nobody came on time. Apparently, there was a lot of traffic on the roads. Kevin was worried, but he started cooking anyway. His guests were mostly old classmates, and they arrived an hour late. Therefore, the food was cold. "Hey, it is still very good!" one friend said.
items.passageZh: 上週六，Kevin 在家裡辦派對，可是沒有一個人準時到。聽說路上車很多。Kevin 很擔心，但還是開始煮菜了。他的客人大多是老同學，他們晚了一個小時才到。因此，菜都涼了。一位朋友說：「嘿，還是很好吃啊！」

rubricZh: 問「給誰」可用 Whom 開頭（較正式），口語用 Who 也正確
過去的問句用 did＋原形動詞（例如 did you call）；寫 phone 等其他動詞也可以
用 ahead 表示「在前面」（例如 ahead、up ahead、ahead of us 等）
「有一家銀行」可寫，例如 There is a bank、There's a bank 等
